# Rule reference

threesock ships 122 built-in rules. External scanners add checks of their own when installed ([tools](tools.md)). Criteria without a rule here are scored MANUAL, with guidance on the evidence to gather.

Run `threesock explain <criterion>` for a criterion's full requirement, checks and red flags.
